snippet.title: Funny Cover Orange game trailer from Johnny-K
snippet.description:
Johnny-K, the developer behind "Cover Orange HD" created a funny little trailer - not to be taken too seriously :) Cover Orange is a unique physics puzzler, published by FDG Entertainment. The game is currently available for the iOS and Android.

Cover Orange (iPhone / iPod touch):
https://itunes.apple.com/app/id405229260

Cover Orange HD (iPad):
https://itunes.apple.com/app/id397731774

Cover Orange (Google Play, FREE):
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.FDGEntertainment.CoverOrange1.gp
